name: Poison Bloom
description: Casts a deadly venom to the target unit, immediately adding %initial_poison% stacks of poison. For the next %duration% turns, the poison debuff duration will tick up instead of down. If the affected unit is attacked by Spitter, the duration is increased by %duration_increase%. If the unit dies under this effect, it will burst and poison nearby enemies equal to the amount of poison stacks it had just before it died.
